notes.title: Update 1.1 - The Aqueduct Update!
notes.content: [p]The waters are rising in Dorpie! Update 1.1 introduces a new building system that will transform how you construct your whimsical vertical towns.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="95BDQc5D98U;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]What's New[/h2][p]Dive into the world of aqueducts and discover an entirely new dimension of building possibilities. These aren't just decorative elements – they're functional waterways that snake through your towering structures, creating mesmerizing networks that bring life to your Dorpie.[/p][p]Connect elevated water sources to distant destinations through cleverly placed aqueduct segments. Watch as crystal-clear water flows through your carefully planned channels, creating stunning visual cascades that complement your architectural masterpieces.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fresh Objectives & Structures[/h2][p]Complete brand new water-themed objectives that challenge you to think like an ancient engineer. Unlock unique aqueduct pieces, water features, and complementary structures that work in harmony with your flowing networks.[/p][p]Whether you're creating simple point-to-point connections or elaborate spaghetti-like networks that weave between buildings, the aqueducts add a new layer of creative expression to your vertical building adventures.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186525/07f80050204eb72d50f786c148201cf5e2db785b.png"][/img][/p][p]The same relaxing, objective-driven gameplay you love, now with the soothing addition of flowing water and the satisfying puzzle of connecting distant points through gravity-defying waterways.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186525/45f580cc5ac9f11341acdc97ff92649bfb393278.png"][/img][/p][p]Ready to make a splash? Your vertical village awaits its first drop of water![/p]
